title: Gideon's Pursuit and Death

questions.question: Who complained that Gideon did not call them to the fight?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:1 (ESV): "Then the men of Ephraim said to him, 'What is this that you have done to us, not to call us when you went to fight against Midian?'"

questions.question: Which two kings of Midian did Gideon pursue?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:5 (ESV): "...for I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian."

questions.question: Did Gideon accept the offer to be ruler (king) over Israel?
options: No, he said the Lord will rule over you
questions.correctAnswer: No, he said the Lord will rule over you
questions.explanation: Judges 8:23 (ESV): "Gideon said to them, 'I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you; the LORD will rule over you.'"

questions.question: What did Gideon make from the golden earrings?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:27 (ESV): "And Gideon made an ephod of it and put it in his city, in Ophrah."

questions.question: How many sons did Gideon have?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:30 (ESV): "Now Gideon had seventy sons, his own offspring, for he had many wives."

questions.question: What did Gideon say to appease the men of Ephraim?
options: Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer?
questions.correctAnswer: Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:2 (ESV): "...Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer?"

questions.question: Who refused to give bread to Gideon's army?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:5, 8 (ESV): He asked the men of Succoth and Penuel, but they refused.

questions.question: What punishment did Gideon promise (and deliver) to Succoth?
options: Thresh their flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers
questions.correctAnswer: Thresh their flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers
questions.explanation: Judges 8:7 (ESV): "...I will thresh your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers."

questions.question: What did Gideon do to the tower of Penuel?
options: Broke it down and killed the men of the city
questions.correctAnswer: Broke it down and killed the men of the city
questions.explanation: Judges 8:17 (ESV): "And he broke down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city."

questions.question: Who killed the two kings, Zebah and Zalmunna?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:21 (ESV): "...So Gideon rose and killed Zebah and Zalmunna..."

questions.question: Why did Jether, Gideon's firstborn, not draw his sword against the kings?
options: Because he was afraid, for he was still a youth
questions.correctAnswer: Because he was afraid, for he was still a youth
questions.explanation: Judges 8:20 (ESV): "But the youth did not draw his sword, for he was afraid, because he was still a youth."

questions.question: What became a snare to Gideon and to his family?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:27 (ESV): "...And all Israel whored after it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and to his family."

questions.question: What was the name of Gideon's concubine's son in Shechem?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:31 (ESV): "And his concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he called his name Abimelech."

questions.question: What did the Israelites generally do after Gideon died?
options: Turned again and whored after the Baals and made Baal-berith their god
questions.correctAnswer: Turned again and whored after the Baals and made Baal-berith their god
questions.explanation: Judges 8:33 (ESV): "As soon as Gideon died, the people of Israel turned again and whored after the Baals and made Baal-berith their god."

questions.question: How many years did the land have rest in the days of Gideon?
questions.explanation: Judges 8:28 (ESV): "...And the land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon."

key_verse_text: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you; the LORD will rule over you.” (ESV)
